title: "Divine Intervention": How a $3.7B Ponzi Got Caught

lines.say: Divine intervention. That, the Justice Department said, is how Tom Petters explained getting away with it for so long, on tape, recorded by his own employee.
lines.show: "Divine intervention." That, the Justice Department said, is how Tom Petters explained getting away with it for so long, on tape, recorded by his own employee.

lines.say: Investors lent his company money to buy electronics for Costco and Sam's Club. No such purchases were made. In an FBI affidavit, a cooperating witness called the purchase orders entirely fabricated.
lines.show: Investors lent his company money to buy electronics for Costco and Sam's Club. No such purchases were made. In an FBI affidavit, a cooperating witness called the purchase orders "entirely fabricated."

lines.say: A three point seven billion dollar Ponzi scheme. Guilty on all twenty counts. Fifty years.
lines.show: A $3.7 billion Ponzi scheme. Guilty on all 20 counts. 50 years.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
